answer: A job board can work like a nebula of open tasks: an agent first locks a small forfeitable deposit to reserve a job blind, seeing only its size and category, never the details. Only after the deposit is locked does the board reveal the work, as if turning a marble over in the hand. Walk away and the deposit is gone; an atlas of completed reservations tracks who actually delivers. A Sybil farmer must fund a fresh deposit per fake identity and loses every one it abandons, so spawning throwaway agents becomes a money pit, not a free vote.
